name: PULSE
author: Alex Sánchez
description: Feel the driver's heart: a heart rate that rises at the start, in a fight, after contact and under pressure, felt on screen (tunnel vision, heartbeat, G, impacts, fatigue) and shown on a bedside monitor, a TV biometrics card and a report.

options.label: Screen effects
options.description: Feel the heart on screen: tunnel vision when it races, the heartbeat at the edges, G greyout in fast corners, the flash and blur of an impact, and fatigue late in a long race.

options.label: Effects strength
options.description: How strong the screen effects are. Changes straight away in game.

options.label: Effects style
options.description: Comfort: no blur, flash, heartbeat throb or grain, a softer tunnel vision, and fatigue only dims the picture a little. For anyone who feels unwell with moving edges.

options.label: Screen motion
options.description: Reduced halves the throb and blur and eases the tunnel in and out. Static: nothing throbs, flashes, blurs or crawls; the edges only darken, slowly.

options.label: Tunnel vision
options.description: The edges darken and lose colour when the heart is in the red zone.

options.label: Heartbeat
options.description: A soft throb at the edges, in time with the heart, when it beats fast.

options.label: G greyout
options.description: The outside edge darkens in fast corners and the top edge under hard braking.

options.label: Impacts
options.description: A flash and a moment of blur after contact, and a shorter blur after a spin or a trip off the road.

options.label: Fatigue
options.description: Late in a long, hard race the picture turns a little softer and grainier.

options.label: Monitor key
options.description: Shows and hides the monitor, and closes the report (Esc closes it too). Pick another if an addon of yours uses F9.

options.label: Biometrics card
options.description: In a race, a TV-style card compares your heart with your rival's when you fight for a few seconds or touch.

options.label: Pulse report
options.description: When you take the flag, your race ends or a session ends: your peak and average heart rate, the time in each zone, your stamina and a zone control score.

options.label: Report position
options.description: Where the Pulse report shows. Left or right keep the middle of the screen free for the game's own end of race (driver of the day, the podium).

options.label: Effects key
options.description: A key that switches the screen effects off and on while you drive.

options.label: Diagnostics in the log
options.description: Writes what PULSE reads from the game to loader.log (a line a second for two minutes, then every 10 s). Leave it on if you send a bug report.
